title: Terrain overview descriptor
description: Engine-owned record of a published terrain overview PNG (CT-23, ADR-8596, docs/formats/terrain.md § 16), written beside it as <name>.overview.json: source identity, settings, image-to-world mapping, orientation, legend, markers, cache key and the cross-architecture comparison tolerance. Overviews are presentation-only. Kept in step with the writer by regia_terrain's test `the_json_schema_names_every_descriptor_field`.

overview_descriptor.description: Descriptor version. A reader that sees another version treats the pair as not cached and bakes again.

algorithm.description: Version of the pixels a source and settings bake to (OVERVIEW_ALGORITHM_VERSION). Part of the cache key.

cache_key.description: BLAKE3 (hex) of the algorithm version, the input digest, the decoded source, the settings and the markers.

descriptor_digest.description: BLAKE3 (hex) of the compact JSON of every other field, object keys sorted (version 2, ADR-8871). A reader that finds another value treats the pair as not cached: an edited or added field anywhere bakes again.

presentation_only.description: Overview images are never simulation input.

file.description: The PNG's file name, in the descriptor's folder.

blake3.description: BLAKE3 of the PNG file. A PNG that does not hash to it is not the published overview.

missing_pixels.description: Pixels painted missing_rgb (no source data under them).

input_digest.description: BLAKE3 of the source, mapping and raster descriptor files as terrain.inspect_source reads them; empty when the caller had none.

content_digest.description: BLAKE3 of the decoded grid, datum, scale, spacing, first sample, counts and valid mask.

sample0_m.description: World X/Z of the south-west sample's center.

fit.description: stretch: the source fills the image (legacy); preserve_aspect: one scale, centered, letterbox_rgb around it.

light.description: Direction from the ground to the light, [X, up, Z].

mapping.description: World X/Z = world_min.x + (u - content_px.x) * meters_per_pixel.x, world_max.z - (v - content_px.y) * meters_per_pixel.z, with (u, v) continuous pixel coordinates.

content_px.description: [x, y, width, height] of the source rectangle in the image.

world_min.description: World X/Z of the source rectangle's west and south edges (half a spacing beyond the first sample).

world_max.description: World X/Z of its east and north edges.

scale_bar_m.description: A round length (1, 2 or 5 times a power of ten meters), at most a quarter of the source rectangle's width.

pixel.description: The pixel holding the marker's center; null outside the source rectangle (not drawn).

tolerance.description: How far two bakes of one source and settings may differ across architectures.
